declined_to_judge.behavior: Optional full semantic census beyond the changed surfaces.
declined_to_judge.reason: The broad audit preset was interrupted after its task tests; changed-scope override, lint, 51 task tests, protected-Racket parity, and two adversarial surfaces were retained instead.

fixed_findings.finding: Sampler retry ceiling counted yielded candidates instead of actual generator draws.
fixed_findings.resolution: _candidate_stream now accepts max_draws and iterates a finite range; a test forces zero accepted candidates and proves exactly five draws.

fixed_findings.finding: Retained .rkt files had an added newline, so file bytes did not match program_sha256.
fixed_findings.resolution: Programs are written byte-for-byte and tests hash each retained file against the manifest.

fixed_findings.finding: The evidence API accepted a single setting and could report vacuous alternative refutation.
fixed_findings.resolution: Evidence requires at least two distinct settings and the canonical default.

scope: Racket evidence writer and retained hashes
